messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to activate a gradual autoscale bump for dedicated GPU pools tonight at 23:00 UTC. Targets: rdx-prod-gpu-1, rdx-prod-gpu-2, rdx-prod-gpu-3. Plan: 10% minScale bump on pool-1 as a 30m canary, run smoke tests, then rolling to pool-2 and pool-3 with 10m stab windows. @kevin will trigger. Rollback criteria: p99 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 1% for 5m.

aj: ack, 23:00 UTC works for me. I'll be on standby.

kevin: I'll handle the canary apply and the rollouts. Execution notes: first terraform apply against pool-1, then manual promotion for the other pools after smoke pass. Command I'll use:

```
terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool["rdx-prod-gpu-1"] -var='autoscale_min=0.10'
```

kevin: After apply I'll post the deploy id and the terraform plan diff in this thread.

devex: Can we include the perf-smoke script in the checklist? Suggest running /scripts/perf-smoke.sh after the bump for immediate latency checks. Also I'll add a short note to the release docs.

sre-oncall: I'm the on-call for the window. Rollback runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-autoscale-rollback — I will own the rollback if criteria hit. I'll also monitor traces and eviction logs.

maria: Smoke checklist (compact):
1) start loadgen against pool-1: 100 concurrent streams for 5m
2) watch p50/p95/p99 in realtime dashboard
3) check for OOMs / GPU evictions in node logs
4) validate key traces through x-request-id and sampling
Tag anything urgent with #inc and ping @sre-oncall.

kevin: smoke command I'm going to run:

```
./tools/loadgen --target rdx-prod-gpu-1 --rps 100 --duration 300
```

lina: small question — will this change affect burst pools or preemptible pools? Need to ensure burst stays sticky for latency-sensitive routes.

maria: burst pools are unchanged by this autoscale min bump — policy targets dedicated minScale only. @aj can you confirm the policy scope?

aj: confirmed, the policy change only touches dedicated minScale settings; burst & preemptible policies untouched.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: autoscale-bump canary for rdx-prod-gpu-1 at 2025-11-07T23:00Z by kevin. ID: dpl-2172468100

kevin: After canary completes (assuming smoke pass), I'll wait a 10m stabilization window, then sequence apply to rdx-prod-gpu-2, wait 10m, then rdx-prod-gpu-3. If any step fails, revert the last apply and run rollback runbook.

devex: I'll open a release-notes PR (#3421) with the rollout steps and a short ops checklist. Please add any missing items.

maria: If anyone cannot make the window or has objections, flag them now. Otherwise proceed as planned.

kevin: :thumbsup: will post the terraform plan in 10m and the deploy id once started.

aj: I'll stand by for rollback support and coordinate with infra if we need extra capacity.

sre-oncall: Monitoring setup: traces + alerting for p99 spike and error rate. I'll post updates during the canary.

maria: Thanks all — let's keep updates concise here during the rollout and escalate to #inc if we hit rollback criteria.
